title: A logo or picture can be brought into a video for a title
goal: The title walkthrough puts a logo on a lower third from the Library. Today Import Media takes only movies and sounds, and an SVG dropped from the Finder does nothing and says nothing. A picture or a logo should come in like any other media and sit on a track with an in and an out.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-title-wt.html steps 6-8 (Library holds svg, png, a logo). Code: EditorState+LibraryImport.swift ~20-21 and ~58-78 take movies and audio only; MediaDrop.swift ~21-26 returns nil for pictures; EditorState.swift ~2237-2238 reads a dropped picture with CGImageSourceCreateWithURL, which cannot read SVG. No SVG reader in Sources. Pixels stay in ImageStore, never in the model. Searches 'import svg', 'clip art', 'import media pictures': only SVG export tasks.
acceptance: Reproduced first at Next defaults: Import Media with a PNG, and a Finder drop of an SVG, on the sample recording; the log quotes what each did
Import Media takes PNG, JPEG and HEIC into the video's Library, and a tile drags onto the timeline or the picture as a layer with an in and an out

An SVG is either brought in (sharp at any size) or refused with a short note saying so; never a silent nothing. If a real SVG reader is more than this sitting, the refusal ships and the reader is filed as its own task

A walk at Next defaults covers the PNG path and passes twice; audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults on the sample recording (walk /tmp/photonz-repro/repro.json, Scripts/playtest.sh --no-build): importPicks [Acme Logo.png] + action importMedia -> log 'File > Import Media...', layers 1 -> 1, no notice raised (MediaFiles.kind is nil for a picture, so importMedia returns nil silently; the Open panel itself greys PNG out). dropOnLibrary Acme Logo.svg -> 'let go on the Library shelf, which stayed dark; the shelf holds 1 recordings and sounds, was 1, and the document 1 layers, was 1', no notice. dropImage Acme Logo.svg on the canvas -> 'the canvas refused the file Acme Logo.svg' (draggingEntered returned none), no words.

Adversarial pass before building: a Premiere editor imports a logo then drags it to V2; today that tile drop did nothing (tile carries no file), so the timeline route was built too, landing like a title (free track or new one, never covers a clip) for 5s, Premiere's still length. The mock promises SVG sharp at any size; macOS reads SVG (NSImage gives _NSSVGImageRep) but the ImageStore keeps one bitmap per ref, so vector-sharp is more than this sitting: refusal shipped, reader filed as an-svg-logo-comes-into-a-video-and-stays-sharp-a.

Built: DocumentMediaSource.Media.picture(ImageRef) (core); DocumentMedia.items lists shelved pictures (uses 0, 'not used yet', captioned with the file name); MediaFiles.isPicture/isVector/vectorRefusal; LibraryImport.notYet; PictureClip.lengthMS + PhotonzDocument.landPicture; PackageIO saves shelved pictures; ProjectMedia skips them. App: Import Media takes png/jpeg/heic/heif/tiff/gif/bmp/webp (+svg, refused in words), shelf drop keeps picture files, canvas shows the SVG note under the pointer, any window drop of an SVG raises a Not added pill, picture tile onto the timeline (EditorState+TimelinePicture). Gotcha: UTType(DocumentImageDrag.typeIdentifier) is nil (type not declared in Info.plist) so '?? .data' matched every file; tiles are told from Finder files by fileURL and DocumentImageDrag.idInFlight instead. Harness: dropOnTimeline carries picture tiles; dropOnLibrary stops waiting on a new picture or a notice.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 13366 tests passed; library-picture-import-walk passed twice (with and without rebuild), plus library-import, drop-a-sound-or-a-video, add-media-at-playhead, empty-track-slot and 8 timeline file-drop walks. Looked at every audit picture: logo tile on the shelf, 'Picture · New V2 · 0:02' over the timeline, logo on V2 0:02-0:07 over the footage, logo on the picture where dropped with an in and out, SVG note legible under the pointer and in the pill. Filed: an-svg-logo-comes-into-a-video-and-stays-sharp-a (p2), a-title-or-a-logo-laid-over-a-video-lands-on-a-t (p1, mock's Gfx/Title track names). Left rough (no task, under the bar): a Finder PNG let go on the timeline still lands on the picture at the playhead rather than the track under the pointer; a tile on the picture runs playhead-to-end vs 5s on the timeline (existing rules).

Import Media and Library drops take PNG/JPEG/HEIC onto the video's Media shelf; a picture tile lands on the timeline on its own track for 5s (or on the picture where dropped) with an in and out; SVG refused in words on shelf, canvas and window. Commit 009cd9c0. Verified: test.sh 13366 green, library-picture-import-walk passed twice at Next defaults, related walks green. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-16-library-picture-import.json.
